title: Experiments of the paper "Modeling marine- and lake-terminated glaciers on GPUs with physics-informed machine learning (IGM v3.3.0)"
description: Configuration files, user modules, input data, scripts and derived data to reproduce the experiments and figures of the paper "Modeling marine- and lake-terminated glaciers on GPUs with physics-informed machine learning (IGM v3.3.0)" submitted to Geoscientific Model Development: the calving-front verification on the unconfined ice shelf of Albrecht et al. (2011), the MISMIP+ experiments, the applications to Sermeq Kujalleq, Pine Island Glacier and Mendenhall Glacier (reference and neural-network runs), and the cost of the Newton-CG solver, including its comparison with PISM.
